description: Capabilities a client may support. Known capabilities are defined here, in this schema, but this is not a closed set: any client can define its own, additional capabilities.

experimental.description: Experimental, non-standard capabilities that the client supports.

roots.description: Present if the client supports listing roots.

listChanged.description: Whether the client supports notifications for changes to the roots list.

sampling.description: Present if the client supports sampling from an LLM.
